architectureVerification.method: file(1) run directly against both the installer and the embedded application binary in this build environment

provenance.builtDuring: Phase 3.8 (Offline Service Replay + Professional Church Operator Workspace) - rebuilt to package the Service Replay screen (transcript paste/file-load, sequential timed segment scheduling with pause/resume/stop/restart, sample transcript) and its pure segmentation/timing helpers

provenance.note: This artifact supersedes the Phase 2.7.1 installer (previously SHA-256 7d2834d387a16a7f03347b8b49c27b3e850903aa4720ec21b8db8dff69f0f6b5) because this phase replaced apps/desktop/src/components/testcenter/TestCenter.tsx with apps/desktop/src/components/servicereplay/ServiceReplay.tsx (+ replay.ts pure logic), renamed the top-level nav entry from 'Offline Test Center' to 'Service Replay', and added zero backend changes (no new Tauri command, no new migration - see the Phase 3.8 audit for why none was justified). releaseCandidateStatement: This is the Phase 3.8 SOFTWARE RELEASE CANDIDATE for Windows x64 (Offline Service Replay + Professional Church Operator Workspace). It is a real, verifiable build artifact - not a placeholder, not a simulation, not a fabrication. See docs/phase-3-8-service-replay-operator.md for the full PASS/HOLD breakdown and final gate.
physicalHardwareStatement: Physical hardware qualification has NOT been performed in the build environment. This installer has not been installed, launched, or tested on any real Windows machine. No real microphone, no real Whisper transcription, no real second display/projector, and no real human operator workflow has been exercised against this build. Xvfb, simulated audio, virtual displays, automated tests, Service Replay, and cross-compilation success are Environment A/B evidence only and are never substituted for Environment C (real hardware) evidence anywhere in this project's documentation.
githubReleaseStatus: NOT CONFIGURED - no .github/workflows directory exists in this repository, and no GitHub Release has been created for this artifact. This installer is available only via this repository's working tree (release/windows/), not via GitHub Releases or any CI/CD pipeline.
obtainingWithoutDeveloperTooling: The file at release/windows/Church Intelligence Platform_0.1.0_x64-setup.exe can be copied/transferred directly (e.g. via a git clone of this repository, a direct file download, or a USB drive) to the target Windows machine and run there. Running the installer on Windows requires none of: Claude Code, Rust, Cargo, Node.js, npm, or the CIP source tree - only the .exe file itself.
knownLimitations: UNSIGNED release candidate - Windows SmartScreen will show an 'unknown publisher' warning on first run
